claim: Taste Labs raised $18.5M and is building a human-curated taste layer plus Brand API to score and improve AI-generated creative outputs.
verifiedFacts: Business Insider reports $18.5M raised and tens of millions in revenue.
Taste Labs uses a network of roughly 1,000 tastemakers and focuses initially on visual design.
Its Brand API is intended to preserve brand consistency across AI-generated materials.
inference: Creative AI differentiation is moving from generation to evaluation, taste calibration and brand-consistency infrastructure.

Consultancy implication: Observation should measure accepted creative quality, not novelty; the service can encode explicit taste criteria and human review. Project disposition: Observation Ad Pipeline PRODUCTIZE; Visual Mechanism Compiler INCUBATE.
significance: High: the market is paying for taste/evaluation layers as an antidote to slop.
assumptions: Funding and revenue figures are directionally accurate.
knownLimitations: Secondary source; company claims are not independently audited; taste criteria remain partly proprietary.
